notes: The supporting article was not included in the fixture.

limitations: No exact product, service, or system version is identified.

locator.quotedText: Countering drone attacks on high-value fixed sites

limitations: The post does not define threat classes, geometry, duration, or success metrics.

locator.description: The post describes detection systems, electronic warfare, and interceptors integrated into one solution.

limitations: The post provides no configuration, interface, or test record.

locator.quotedText: at a fraction of the cost of legacy air defence systems

locator.description: The post describes a managed service integrating systems and operational delivery.

claims.statement: Swarmer identifies the offering as Vectus Air Defense Systems.
Swarmer states that Vectus is intended to counter drone attacks on high-value fixed sites.
limitations: This proves the advertised outcome, not outcome achievement.

claims.statement: Swarmer states that Vectus combines detection, electronic warfare, interceptors, and managed operation.
limitations: No operating configuration or integration result is supplied.

claims.statement: Swarmer claims that the offering costs a fraction of legacy air-defense systems.
limitations: The evidence cell proves that the claim was made, not the claimed cost relationship.
